claims.gist: By 2023 over half of global GDP will come from digitally transformed enterprises
Over 50% of ICT spending goes to digital transformation by 2023
70% of enterprises will integrate public and private clouds by 2022
Over 50% of new enterprise infrastructure will sit at the edge by 2023
At least 90% of new enterprise apps will embed AI by 2025
Enterprises unable to compete digitally will lose ground in core markets

thesis: IDC predicts digital supremacy by 2023, forcing faster cloud, edge and AI investment and new operating models.
